title: The ward committee wants a meeting
body: Not about anything specific. That is the point — they have heard about the project from someone who is not you.

choices.text: Skip it, the EIA deadline is closer

title: A wet quarter
body: The access track is impassable for six weeks. Everything on site stops; the paperwork does not.

title: A land claim is lodged
body: Over a portion of site 4. It may take years. It may be withdrawn next quarter. Nobody will tell you which.

title: The DFI adds a condition precedent
body: A social and labour plan, signed by parties who have not yet agreed to be parties.

title: The wholesaler offers to fund the forecourt
body: Capital up front, a supply agreement for fifteen years, and a margin that is theirs.

title: A rumour about the water
body: Someone at the municipality says the aquifer is thinner than the district plan claims. They will not put it in writing.

title: The contractor is not local
body: Cheaper by nine percent, and forty men from the ward were not called.

title: The municipality is placed under administration
body: Every signature you were waiting on now belongs to someone who has not read the file.

choices.text: Wait for the dust to settle

title: The school asks for the sports field back
body: They have been asking since before you arrived. This time they have written to the district.

title: Diesel price shock
body: Everything trucked in costs more this quarter, and everything is trucked in.
